text:
Rao: FYI ran quick onboard of v3.2-int4 on 2% traffic. Bench shows small quality win but long-context failures cropping up. posting bench-bot excerpt.
Maya: drop the numbers pls.
Rao: bench-bot: 

```
Overall: MRR +0.4% | p50 +5ms | p99 +60ms
Slices:
- quick-qa: MRR +1.0 | p99 +12ms
- convo-multi: MRR +0.3 | p99 +48ms
- longctx-docs: MRR -0.6 | p95 +180ms | p99 +420ms | p999 +950ms
- safety-heavy: flat
```

Claudia: p999 ~1s on longctx is concerning for customers hitting timeouts. any infra signals?
Rao: infra logs: no GPU queue spikes, but runtime reported ~0.7% kernel-fallbacks on attention for >4k tokens. also host tokenization latency rises for extremely large blobs.
Maya: kernel-fallbacks correlate with our fallback-to-gemm path for quant kernels on odd seq lengths. could be alignment padding issue.
Claudia: proposal: add a per-slice safety-circuit in rollout config that does staged throttle -> shadow replay -> full fallback. include capture_sample and kernel_trace when circuit trips.
Rao: proto rule I pushed to gating repo: 

```
- id: safety_circuit_longctx_v3_2
  slices: ["longctx-docs"]
  eval_period: 1m
  criteria:
    - metric: p999_latency_ms
      above: 800
    - metric: mrr_pct_delta
      below: -0.4
  actions:
    - name: throttle_traffic
      params: {percent: 50, duration: 10m, capture_sample: true}
    - name: run_shadow
      params: {baseline: "v3.1", compare_window: 15m, capture_kernel_trace: true}
    - name: fallback
      params: {reason: "sustained_slice_hit"}
  hysteresis: 6m
  cooloff: 15m
  oscillation_protection: true
```

Maya: add a soft-step between throttle and shadow: reduce to 75% first then 50% to avoid oscillation when metrics hover.
Claudia: agree. also require 2 consecutive eval periods before escalation to fallback.
bench-bot: scheduled diff job: job=bd-1768888000-shadow-diff -> will post ROUGE/MRR diffs when done.
infra-bot: retention set: /captures/1768888000 -> 14d. sampling: staging=1/100, prod=1/1000.
Rao: ops plan: run synthetic generator that mimics longctx token expansion and odd length alignments in staging; confirm kernel-fallback counts drop after padding fix.
Maya: I'll add diagnostic flag to log kernel selection + attention-block shape to the runtime for sampled requests.
Claudia: timeline? if staging tests pass, we can gate rollout and enable safety_circuit in prod at 1% for 24h.
Rao: I'll open PR with gate yaml + runbook + synthetic pack. PR -> link in thread.
Maya: ping me on review, I want to validate padding patch and diag parses.
Claudia: thanks team. will watch bench-bot diffs.
